verdict.rationale: Poly documents sharing files or folders with specific people (poly-docs-9, poly-docs-33) and Shared Drives with their own members and roles (poly-docs-34, poly-docs-24), so a researcher can share a space with collaborators. On conflicts, it only says that conflicting edits are preserved and recoverable (poly-docs-10, poly-docs-5), which is after-the-fact recovery rather than avoiding stepping on each other's changes. missing for 10: real-time or simultaneous co-editing of notes, conflict prevention or merging (versus recovery after the fact), clear editor permissions on shared content (the sharing doc only says collaborators can 'see' it), independent or hands-on corroboration.
